description: Alias-specific wiring that consumes FEAT-001 (framed bands) + FEAT-002 (cell helpers, scratch row): CE uppercase display fix (3 sites), Alias column metadata + row-to-cells, rebuilt alias_table + markdown section, single-representation screen model, Alias status cells + i18n, goldens, and existing-test updates. Per command-configurator Req 7.14-7.28 / design 9.11 / tasks Task 9. DEPENDS ON FEAT-001 and FEAT-002 being green.
steps: CE uppercase display fix (ce-case-investigation; decision a/e): change the DISPLAY from AliasEnvironment::label() (lowercase) to env_name() (UPPERCASE) at (a) alias_editor_panel/rows.rs::render_ce_combo selected_text + selectable_value; (b) alias_editor_panel/host.rs::render_filter_cells shown text (keep the match eq_ignore_ascii_case). Do NOT change storage, file names, dropdown constraints, or from_env_name. NOTE: this SUPERSEDES the lowercase [ffcmd v] literal in design fixture 9.11.1 / Task 9 wording -- render FFCMD/FFEDIT and regenerate goldens uppercase.

TDD + implement (Task 9.1-9.2): in alias_editor_panel/host.rs extend ALIAS_COLUMNS with the shared with_snapshot builder: Act (Text,4), CE (Combo,10), Command (Combo,20), Alias (Text,16), Parameters (Text,28), Description (Text,32), plain-text headers; add alias_snapshot_cells(&AliasRowEdit) -> Vec<String> returning the six RAW values (act, CE via env_name() UPPERCASE, canonical, surface, command_template, description); placeholders (_ name (&1) note) are never a value; a typed &1 appears; empty stays empty; control chars -> space; a Description with ' | ' stays one value.

TDD + implement (Task 9.3): rebuild shell/screen_providers_tables.rs::alias_table() -- build the displayed set via displayed_indices(&p.rows, p.filter_ce, &p.filter_root) in BACKING order, map each row through alias_snapshot_cells, append the scratch row from alias_snapshot_cells(&AliasRowEdit::default()), call the shared snapshot_table(ALIAS_COLUMNS, ...); filter row is NEVER a table row; empty copy yields only the scratch row; keep caption Some("Aliases"). Add alias_markdown_section() using raw_table (RAW values, no [v]/underscore/padding, no scratch).

TDD + implement (Task 9.4-9.5): in shell/screen_providers.rs::alias_editor_screen_model() delete the fields loop (removes the SS . . . : SNAPSHOT dot-leader AND the | Property | Value | clipboard table) and the self-set model.command_line; push one alias_table() into model.tables and one alias_markdown_section() into model.markdown_sections; keep p.error -> model.messages. The model carries NO header_lines/command_line of its own. Clipboard test: Markdown has the fenced box FIRST, then ### Aliases once, and NO Property/Value table; HTML mirrors it.

TDD + implement (Task 9.7): create shell/workspace_status_alias.rs (<400 lines) with alias_status_cells(&self) -> Vec<String> returning Aliases: <n> (n = rows.len(), scratch excluded), Rows 1-<m> visible (m = displayed_indices len; Rows 0 visible when none), and ONLY while a filter is active Filter: <ce>/<root> with -- for an unset half and CE UPPERCASE (e.g. Filter: FFCMD/--); no cell contains ' | '; use ff_i18n keys following ff-desktop-shell-status-*. Add a KindTag::AliasEditor arm to render_status.rs::workspace_status_cells() BEFORE the FileEditor/Untitled early return; register the new module in the shell mod list. Live/snapshot parity is by construction (one method); the common Last|Prof|Zoom precede the Alias cells (common_frame.rs, unchanged).

Goldens (Task 9.6): regenerate crates/ff-desktop/src/shell/golden/alias_pfshow_on.txt, alias_message_pfshow_off.txt, alias_message_pfshow_off_ascii.txt to the framed-band + UPPERCASE layout (grid merged into frame rules, [FFCMD v], six columns with conventions, trailing scratch row, Alias status cells after Last|Prof|Zoom, no dot-leader, no nested box, no caption row). Add alias_pfshow_off_rows.txt (design 9.11.1 layout, UPPERCASE CE; working copy: row1 X/FFCMD/EXIT/empty/"Exit the application"; row2 SS/FFCMD/SNAPSHOT/empty/empty; row3 CS/FFCMD/CAPTURE START/"&1"/"Session Recording start"; then scratch row; status Aliases: 3, Rows 1-3 visible). Add alias_filtered.txt (filter FFCMD/SNAPSHOT => matching row + scratch, status ends Filter: FFCMD/SNAPSHOT) + an ASCII variant. Write tests_alias_golden.rs (sibling of tests_common_frame_golden.rs): build the shell with the three-row working copy set directly on alias_editor_panel.rows, take the SNAPSHOT text, assert full-string equality with the golden; assert the X->EXIT seed row is the first data row and editable, the SS empty cells render as underscore runs (never (&1)/note), and no blank/caption row around the grid; register the new test mod.

Existing-test updates (Task 9.9): update alias/CE-case/old-shape assertions in tests_editor_snapshot_tables.rs (alias_screen_model_populates_table_with_real_saved_row now expects FFCMD + the six-column conventions), tests_screen_directive.rs, tests_common_frame_snapshot.rs, tests_common_frame_order.rs, tests_common_frame_helper.rs. Each is a convention update, never a weakened assertion; report any test that looks genuinely wrong instead of editing it.

Compile-only verification + size + handoff (Task 9.8, 9.10): confirm the existing mandatory first-Tab test still lands on the filter CE combo (unchanged, no phantom stop); run the scoped trio for ff-desktop AND ff-screen-model to uniquely named _ignore/logs/ files and read them back; confirm no touched .rs exceeds 400 non-test lines and no common-frame element is drawn by the Alias provider/panel; update docs/quality/TCR.md rows for Req 7.14-7.28 if present.
acceptance_criteria: CE renders UPPERCASE FFCMD/FFEDIT in the editor combo, the filter combo, and the snapshot cell; storage/dropdown constraints unchanged.
ALIAS_COLUMNS declares the six columns with the correct cell kinds + widths; alias_snapshot_cells returns the six RAW values with placeholders excluded and a typed &1 preserved.

alias_table() is the displayed set in backing order + a trailing scratch row via the shared builder, with no filter row; alias_editor_screen_model has NO fields, exactly one table, one markdown_section, error in messages, and no self-set header_lines/command_line.
The Markdown/HTML clipboard is box-first then one ### Aliases table and NO Property/Value table.
workspace_status_cells for the active Alias editor returns Aliases/Rows/Filter per Req 7.25 with FFCMD uppercase and no ' | ' in any cell; live and snapshot use the one method.

The regenerated + new goldens match the SNAPSHOT output line for line (the X->EXIT seed row present and editable; SS empty cells as underscore runs; filtered golden ends Filter: FFCMD/SNAPSHOT); updated existing tests pass.

`cargo test -p ff-desktop` scoped alias/common-frame/golden names pass; clippy -D warnings and fmt --check clean for both crates; every touched .rs under 400 non-test lines; the first-Tab test is unchanged.
verification: cargo check -p ff-desktop  (redirect to a unique _ignore/logs/ log; read it back)
cargo test -p ff-desktop tests_alias_golden  (and alias_table, alias_snapshot_cells, alias_editor_screen_model, alias status-cell, and updated common-frame test names)
cargo check -p ff-screen-model  (ensure the FEAT-001 consumer still builds)
findings:
Implemented in worktree alias-kind-impl, committed locally as 26173b3 (branch alias-kind-impl, 22 files, NOT pushed). Consumes FEAT-001 (framed bands) + FEAT-002 (snapshot cell helpers + scratch row). COMPILE-ONLY verification GREEN for BOTH crates: ff-desktop cargo check / check --tests / clippy --all-targets -D warnings / fmt --check all clean; ff-screen-model check / clippy --all-targets -D warnings / fmt --check all clean. Scoped tests PASS (owner runs the authoritative full gate): alias golden suite (6), ispf_table_editor (58 incl. FEAT-002 scratch-row), tests_editor_snapshot_tables (7), tests_screen_directive, workspace_status_alias (4), host snapshot_tests (4), and the unchanged full_shell_alias_editor_first_tab_focuses_first_interior (still lands on the filter CE combo, no phantom stop).

KEY DECISIONS / FACTS for later steps:
(1) CE DISPLAY is UPPERCASE env_name() at all three sites: rows.rs::render_ce_combo (selected_text + selectable_value) and host.rs::render_filter_cells (shown text). This SUPERSEDES the lowercase [ffcmd v] literal in design 9.11.1; goldens are uppercase ([FFCMD v]). Storage/file names/from_env_name/dropdown constraints UNCHANGED; filter_matches still uses eq_ignore_ascii_case.
(2) ALIAS_COLUMNS widths: Act(Text,4) CE(Combo,10) Command(Combo,20) Alias(Text,16) Parameters(Text,28) Description(Text,32). alias_snapshot_cells returns six RAW sanitised values (CE via env_name UPPERCASE); empty fields stay empty (renderer draws _/[ v]); a typed &1 is preserved; an in-cell ' | ' stays one value. ALIAS_COLUMNS + alias_snapshot_cells + displayed_indices are re-exported pub(crate) from alias_editor_panel/mod.rs (pub use for alias_surface_column only -- the two crate-internal items use pub(crate) use to avoid E0364).
(3) SCRATCH ROW CE: AliasRowEdit::default().environment is Ffcmd, so the trailing scratch row's CE cell is [FFCMD v] (NOT [ v]); its empty Command is [ v] and empty Alias/Params/Desc are underscore runs. This is visible in every golden's last data row -- do not mistake it for a bug.
(4) alias_editor_screen_model() now has NO fields loop and NO self-set command_line/header_lines; exactly one tables entry (alias_table: displayed rows in backing order + scratch, via shared snapshot_table) and one markdown_sections entry (alias_markdown_section: raw_table, no scratch). The common frame (apply_common_frame) owns the Command ===> line, so a test that calls alias_editor_screen_model() directly sees model.command_line empty.
(5) Status cells: shell/workspace_status_alias.rs::alias_status_cells -> [Aliases: <rows.len()>, Rows 1-<visible>/Rows 0 visible, (Filter: <ce>/<root> only when a filter half is set, CE UPPERCASE, -- for the unset half)]. render_status.rs::workspace_status_cells returns these for KindTag::AliasEditor BEFORE the FileEditor/Untitled early return, so live bar and snapshot share one method (parity by construction). i18n keys ff-desktop-shell-status-alias-{count,rows,rows-none,filter} added to en/af/de/fr (English fallback covers any missing non-en key).
(6) Goldens regenerated via assert_golden + FFWB_UPDATE_GOLDEN and reviewed by hand: alias_pfshow_on, alias_message_pfshow_off(+ascii) now framed-band uppercase; NEW alias_pfshow_off_rows (3-row seed X->EXIT first/editable, SS empty->underscores, CS with &1, + scratch, status Aliases: 3 | Rows 1-3 visible), alias_filtered + alias_filtered_ascii (filter FFCMD/SNAPSHOT => one row + scratch, status ends Filter: FFCMD/SNAPSHOT). Box-drawing glyphs are in the .txt fixtures ONLY (ASCII-only .rs source respected).
(7) SIZE: all touched source .rs under 400 non-test lines (host 206, rows 175, screen_providers_tables 189, screen_providers 322, render_status 334, workspace_status_alias 70 non-test). tests_alias_golden.rs is 230 lines -- marginally over the ~200 soft test-file guideline but a cohesive single golden suite (sibling golden test files in this repo far exceed 200); left intact rather than fragmenting the suite.
(8) TCR.md: NO existing rows for Req 7.14-7.28 / CR-NR-116 were found (Step 8 was conditional on 'if present'), so no TCR edit was made -- adding a new TCR phase block is a broader doc change outside this feature's scope and would need its own roadmap-aligned entry.
(9) snapshot.rs still carries its module-level #![allow(dead_code)] (combo_cell/text_cell remain internal-only); clippy -D warnings is clean WITH it, so it was left to avoid churn -- a later step may remove it once a second host consumes those helpers. The seed set was NOT changed by this gate.
